title: kbid.py repoint onto a url that is already a root row leaves a duplicate source id in the citing tags and a duplicate anchor row
goal: kbid.py repoint OLD NEW_URL, where NEW_URL is already a row of the root, leaves every fact that cited both ids with one id once in its tag and one anchor row per fact, path and source, so check.py stays clean

run:
import os, re, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import kbid, kbroot, kbfacts
t = tempfile.mkdtemp()
d = os.path.join(t, "zq")
old_url, new_url = "https://example.org/docs/old-page", "https://example.org/docs/new-page"
old, new = kbid.source_id(old_url, "ZQ"), kbid.source_id(new_url, "ZQ")
fact = "The setting is on by default. [DER %s, %s]"
art = ["---", "topic: win/a", "priority: P1", "applies_to: x", "retrieved_utc: 2026-01-01", "sources: [" + old + ", " + new + "]", "status: complete", "---", "", "# A",
       "", "## Summary", "- Summary line one. [DOC " + new + "]", "", "## Facts", "- " + fact % (old, new), ""]
files = {"_root.md": kbroot.root_md("zq", "ZQ", "internal", "planted"), **{k: v.format(name="zq") for k, v in kbroot.FILES.items()}, "win/a.md": "\n".join(art)}
files["_sources.csv"] += (old + "," + old_url + ",Old,Example Org,CC BY 4.0,quote,2026-01-01,,,win/a.md,\n"
                          + new + "," + new_url + ",New,Example Org,CC BY 4.0,quote,2026-01-01,,,win/a.md,\n")
k0 = kbfacts.fact_key(fact % (old, new))
files["_anchors.csv"] = ("fact,path,source_id,status,heading,terms,sha,quote,verified_utc\n" + k0 + ",win/a.md," + old + ",unlocated:no-match,,,,,2026-01-01\n"
                         + k0 + ",win/a.md," + new + ",unlocated:no-match,,,,,2026-01-01\n")
for rel, text in files.items():
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.join(d, rel)) or d, exist_ok=True)
    open(os.path.join(d, rel), "w", newline="").write(text)
env = dict(os.environ, KB_ROOTS=d)
run = lambda *a: subprocess.run([sys.executable, *a], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
r = run("_tools/kbid.py", "repoint", old, new_url, "--root", "zq")
c = run("_tools/check.py", "--root", "zq")
tag = [m for m in re.findall(r"\[DER ([^\]]*)\]", open(os.path.join(d, "win/a.md")).read()) if "," in m or m]
dup = any(len(set(x.replace(" ", "").split(","))) != len(x.replace(" ", "").split(",")) for x in tag)
print("repoint exit", r.returncode, "check exit", c.returncode, "tags", tag, "duplicate id in a tag:", dup, c.stdout[-200:])
sys.exit(1 if dup or c.returncode else 0)
